name: black-shore
description: AI-powered digital office agent — bendahara & sekertaris dalam satu karakter 3D

scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:backend && bun run deploy:frontend
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd apps/backend && npx wrangler d1 execute black-shore-db --local --file=migrations/0001_initial.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd apps/backend && npx wrangler d1 execute black-shore-db --remote --file=migrations/0001_initial.sql
scripts.db:list: cd apps/backend && npx wrangler d1 list
